About the Position

Berlin's IMPRS Biology and Computation recruits doctoral researchers working across biological questions and computational methods. No IELTS or TOEFL certificate is required; English is assessed through the application and interviews.

Funding Depends on the Host

The funded offer applies to IMPRS faculty placements. Candidates joining affiliated groups must confirm their support with the prospective supervisor; admission alone does not guarantee that funding.

About the Project

Berlin's IMPRS Biology and Computation recruits doctoral researchers working across biological questions and computational methods. The programme has a central application deadline followed by a later reference deadline, and candidates should prepare both parts of the submission in time.

Research Areas

  • Computational biology
  • Biology
  • Data analysis

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryThree-year funding for positions with IMPRS faculty; affiliated-group placements require separate funding confirmation.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsBiology and computational research; admission requirements on official call.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round7 December 2026, 23:59 CET; references 14 December
LocationGermany

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.molgen.mpg.de/IMPRS/application

Source: molgen.mpg.de - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 7 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 7 December 2026, 23:59 CET; references 14 December. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Email a PhD Supervisor: 7 Templates and Practical Tips
  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Studying in Germany: Tuition Fees, Living Costs and Funding

English language requirements

This structured German doctoral programme does not ask for IELTS or TOEFL scores at admission; the programme runs in English and proficiency is assessed through your written application, references and interviews. You can include a test score if you have one, but its absence does not weaken an application.
stipend: Approx. €3,010/month gross (TV-L E13, 65% — typical doctoral level)
